notes:
Bruno imports now preserve original variable references such as `{{agreement-host}}` and collection/environment ownership, along with collection, folder and subfolder structure.

- Review Environments before Requests in the refreshed Import screen.
- Copy selected variables from one saved Environment to another with explicit conflict handling.
- Type Environment names continuously without losing focus or the cursor position during review.
- Import preview details start collapsed and retain your manual expansion.
- Recover from interrupted review with Retry while retaining your choices.

Existing imported Requests keep their saved configuration until you explicitly re-import and choose Update in review. The update is optional for supported installed versions; the minimum supported version remains 0.1.1.

New Bruno scope metadata uses updated workspace schemas. Older Rove versions reject these files rather than losing the imported scope information; collaborators opening them should use this release or newer.

Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon packages are built from the same source commit. Updater payloads are signed with the existing Rove update key. macOS uses ad-hoc platform signing; Apple notarization and Windows certificate signing are not included in this beta.
